item.title: Exploring the Character Dynamics Between Ritsu and the Band in BanG Dream! YUME∞MITA
item.content:encoded: It's official! As of the sixth episode of BanG Dream! YUME∞MITA, Ritsu will be joining her childhood friend Arale and the other members of MewType in the band. Ritsu is leaving behind an extremely dangerous dynamic with her previous group Fairy Bouquet and chief series antagonist Viola, which can and will spell conflict going forward, but it also means that Ritsu now has a whole new group of decidedly more accommodating associates.

item.title: Mobile Suit Gundam Hathaway: The Sorcery of Nymph Circe Anime Film Review
item.content:encoded: If deep character explorations and interpersonal drama are your cup of tea, you'll get your fill. If you're just in it for giant robots fighting each other, you'll get that too.
